items.title: Confirm broad-scan token baseline and affected prompts
items.context: Reconfirm the decisions corpus size and locate exact full-scan instructions in scope-plan and behavior prompts. Evidence should include file counts/word or byte counts and prompt line references. Do not rely on memory alone.
items.userSees: A short evidence summary identifies the token-heavy scans and the two prompt surfaces that must change.

happy.desc: find/wc reproduce the decisions corpus baseline (~111 files / ~2.4MB) and rg locates the full-scan instructions at the cited lines in both templates

edge.desc: baseline recorded with exact literal commands so same-day corpus drift (plus/minus a file) is detectable and explainable rather than silently stale

adversarial.desc: pre-edit diff proves mirrors are byte-identical to templates so the baseline cannot hide pre-existing mirror drift

verificationEvidence.command: sh -c 'find docs/requirements/decisions -name "*.md" | wc -l; find docs/requirements/decisions -name "*.md" -exec cat {} + | wc -w; find docs/requirements/decisions -name "*.md" -exec cat {} + | wc -c'; rg -n -e "Always scan the \*\*full decisions/ directory\*\*" -e "You must Read every \.md file" -e "Read every \.md file one by one" -e "always defer to the full decisions/ directory" packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md; rg -n -e "full directory scan of" -e "all \.md files under" packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-behavior.md
verificationEvidence.note: Reproduced baseline: 111 md files / 319,612 words / 2,400,226 bytes in docs/requirements/decisions. Full-scan instructions located at scope-plan lines 117/122/142/191 and behavior lines 126/160, matching the story-cited surfaces.

Baseline bound as literal re-runnable commands; live count 111 vs story-creation snapshot 112 is recorded with the drift explanation in background.md, so same-day corpus drift is detectable and explained rather than silently stale.
All four pre-edit diffs empty: both templates byte-identical to their .claude and .lattice-codex mirrors, so the baseline cannot hide pre-existing mirror drift.

items.title: Add bounded memory/playbook preflight requirement to broad-scan prompts
items.context: Update scope-plan and behavior prompt templates so any broad docs/spec scan first consumes bounded Memory Runtime Preflight or dev_memory_preflight/search plus active playbook advisory when available. State clearly that memory/playbook output is advisory only and cannot satisfy gate evidence.
items.userSees: Reviewer prompts now start broad-scan work with bounded memory/playbook context instead of immediately reading the full decisions directory.

happy.desc: rendered agent_prompt for both roles contains the bounded memory/playbook preflight step ordered before any decisions read

edge.desc: preflight wording covers the memory-surface-unavailable case: proceed with candidate routing, never fall back to a full scan

adversarial.desc: wording states advisory-only / gateEvidence=false verbatim so a reviewer cannot cite memory or playbook output as gate evidence

verificationEvidence.command: node bin/lattice.js agent_prompt --role=lattice-review-scope-plan | rg -n "Bounded memory/playbook preflight"; node bin/lattice.js agent_prompt --role=lattice-review-behavior | rg -n "Bounded memory/playbook preflight first"
verificationEvidence.note: Rendered prompts for both roles open the search-strategy path with the bounded memory/playbook preflight step, ordered before any decisions read (scope-plan search budget contract step 1; behavior spec-boundary step first bullet).

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "never substitute a full directory read for a missing preflight" packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-behavior.md
verificationEvidence.note: Both templates explicitly cover the memory-surface-unavailable case: proceed to candidate routing, never substitute a full directory read.
Both templates state verbatim that memory/playbook output is advisory only, non-authoritative (gateEvidence=false), and can never satisfy or be cited as gate evidence.

items.title: Replace default full decisions scan with candidateSpecSet-first routing
items.context: Change prompt instructions so candidateSpecSet is generated or consumed before full scan. Sources should include relatedDocs, story title/description/risk signals, changed files/symbols, command/config names, aux_doc_list, and top-N rg matches. Full scan remains available only with scanEscalationReason.
items.userSees: The default reviewer flow uses candidate docs first and records why any full decisions scan was escalated.

happy.desc: scope-plan default flow: enumerate decisions filenames, build candidateSpecSet from the six listed sources, full-read only candidate members within the N<=15 budget

edge.desc: candidate-ambiguity path instructs escalation with a recorded scanEscalationReason instead of guessing when triage is unclear

adversarial.desc: candidateSpecSet cannot degenerate to relatedDocs-only: mandatory enumeration plus keyword-match wording exists and the static guard asserts the phrases

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Enumerate decisions/ filenames completely|Build the candidateSpecSet|full-read at most 15 candidate docs|Read full content only for candidateSpecSet members" packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Scope-plan default flow: complete filename enumeration, candidateSpecSet built from the six sources (relatedDocs, story metadata/riskSignals, changed files/symbols, command/config names, aux_doc_list, top-N rg matches), full reads capped at 15 candidates, triage for the rest.
Candidate ambiguity is an explicit scanEscalationReason trigger in both templates; scope-plan step 4(a) additionally instructs escalation instead of guessing when triage suggests hidden commitments.
relatedDocs-alone is forbidden wording is present, and the guard smoke asserts candidateSpecSet/scanEscalationReason/advisory-only/gateEvidence=false phrases exist in all six copies.

items.title: Forbid REVIEW behavior from default full decisions scans
items.context: Behavior review should consume scope_check_save, current diff, current story commitments, userSees, and transcript context. It may full-scan only for high-risk lifecycle/gate/process-fact/global rename/candidate ambiguity/explicit reviewer escalation with a recorded scanEscalationReason.
items.userSees: Behavior review no longer repeats scope-plan's historical decisions sweep during normal REVIEW.

happy.desc: behavior spec-boundary step consumes scope_check_save result, current diff, story commitments, and candidate docs by default; no unconditional full-scan wording remains

edge.desc: the five escalation triggers are enumerated verbatim so high-risk lifecycle/gate stories still get a full scan with a recorded reason

adversarial.desc: finding taxonomy unchanged (category=missing with spec-boundary: desc prefix) so the token change cannot silently alter review semantics

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Default inputs: the .lattice scope_check_save. result" packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-behavior.md && node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Replayable replacement for the earlier CHK-004 happy row (whose rg used --include-zero without --count and would error on replay): positive match proves the new default-input wording at line 129, and the guard smoke enforces zero unconditional full-scan phrases across all six copies.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "high-risk lifecycle/gate change, process-fact change, global rename, candidate ambiguity, explicit reviewer escalation" packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-behavior.md packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: All five escalation triggers are enumerated verbatim in both templates so high-risk stories still get a full scan with a recorded scanEscalationReason.
Finding taxonomy untouched: category=missing with spec-boundary: desc prefix wording remains exactly as before the search-strategy change.

items.title: Synchronize materialized prompt assets if required
items.context: If the repository uses full materialized Claude/Codex prompt copies, update the mirrored .claude and .lattice-codex prompt assets consistently with templates, or run the existing generator if available. Do not invent unrelated prompt changes.
items.userSees: Codex and Claude prompt assets expose the same bounded search behavior as the source templates.

happy.desc: post-edit diff shows template equals .claude mirror for both roles; .lattice-codex differs only by the known .claude/agents path substitution

edge.desc: lattice check reports no managed-asset drift for the touched agent files after sync

adversarial.desc: guard smoke scans all six copies so a stale mirror keeping old full-scan wording fails the test

verificationEvidence.note: All four post-edit diffs empty: templates and both mirror sets are byte-identical (these two prompts contain no .claude/agents path references, so the codex substitution is a no-op, matching pre-edit state).

lattice check drift report contains no entries for the four touched agent mirror files; the three reported items (gitignore runtime patterns, AGENTS.md managed section, codex pretool hook) are pre-existing repo-level staleness unrelated to this story and were left untouched.
Guard smoke scans all six copies (two templates + two .claude + two .lattice-codex); the red demonstration was performed on a .claude mirror specifically, proving stale-mirror wording fails the test.

items.title: Add static regression tests for broad-scan budget rules
items.context: Add a focused prompt scan or task test that fails if active reviewer prompts reintroduce unconditional phrases such as read every decisions file, always scan the full decisions directory, or behavior default full decisions scan without escalation language. The test should allow explicit escalation-path wording.
items.userSees: Automated checks prevent the old default full-scan instructions from returning.

happy.desc: new reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke passes against the updated six prompt copies

edge.desc: legitimate scanEscalationReason escalation wording does not false-positive the banned-phrase patterns

adversarial.desc: red demonstration: temporarily reintroducing an unconditional full-scan phrase into one copy makes the smoke exit non-zero

verificationEvidence.note: New guard passes on the updated six prompt copies: 0 banned unconditional broad-scan phrases, 4 required bounded-search phrases present, positive controls green.

Escalation-path wording does not false-positive: templates contain multiple scanEscalationReason lines describing full-scan escalation and the guard exempts them (in-test positive control asserts the exemption).

verificationEvidence.command: sed -i '' 's/^## Rules$/## Rules\n\n- Always scan the **full decisions\/ directory**./' .claude/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md; node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js; cp packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md .claude/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Red demonstration executed: reintroducing the legacy phrase into .claude/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md made the smoke exit 1 flagging line 195 [always scan full decisions]; restoring the mirror returned exit 0.

items.title: Verify prompt output and record expected token-savings evidence
items.context: Run the relevant prompt/adaptor checks, inspect agent_prompt output for the changed roles, and record before/after search budget evidence. Expected result: default flow no longer reads all 111 decision docs (live count re-verified 2026-07-09) unless scanEscalationReason is present.
items.userSees: Verification shows the stopgap is active and explains the expected reduction from full decisions scans to bounded memory plus candidate docs.

happy.desc: agent_prompt output for both roles contains the new bounded wording and lacks unconditional full-scan wording; build and guard smoke green

edge.desc: before/after budget evidence records the default-path reduction from 111 full-content reads to at most 15 candidate reads plus filename triage

adversarial.desc: all evidence commands bound literally via verification_evidence_add so the delivery reviewer can re-run them verbatim

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node bin/lattice.js agent_prompt --role=lattice-review-scope-plan; node bin/lattice.js agent_prompt --role=lattice-review-behavior; node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Worktree-rendered prompts contain the new bounded wording (scope-plan: 7x candidateSpecSet / 5x scanEscalationReason / 2x advisory only / 1x gateEvidence=false; behavior: 4x/3x/2x/1x) and zero unconditional full-scan phrases; build and guard green. Note: the globally installed lattice CLI renders from the installed package, so worktree verification must use node bin/lattice.js.

Before/after budget: previous default instructed full-content reads of all 111 decisions docs (~2,400,226 bytes) on every scope-plan AND behavior run; new default is bounded preflight + at most 15 candidate full reads + filename triage, cutting default spec-reading volume by roughly 85-100 docs per reviewer run, with full scans only under a recorded scanEscalationReason.
Every evidence row on CHK-001..CHK-007 binds the literal re-runnable command used, so the delivery reviewer can replay each verification verbatim from the worktree.
